name: FlContainers Guacamole
description: A Docker Container for Apache Guacamole, a client-less remote desktop gateway. It supports standard protocols like VNC, RDP, and SSH over HTML5.

questions.label: Web port
questions.hint: The port on this server that opens the app.

compose:
# Define the services required for the application
services:
  # app service configuration
  app:
    # Docker image to use for this service
    image: flcontainers/guacamole:1.6.0@sha256:81a420f386ef8cbb4697208e13ea90f6a10a54619981241bed672e4a41b5f77f
    # Container name
    container_name: big-bear-flcontainers-guacamole
    # Restart policy for the container
    restart: always
    # Environment variables for the app service
    environment:
      tz: "UTC"
      EXTENSIONS: "auth-totp,auth-ldap"
    # Map port 8080 on the host to port 8080 on the container
    ports:
      - "${APP_PORT}:8080"
